notes: The original page and each supplied full-resolution overlapping half were personally viewed once before the crop stage. Every live word, symbol, sign, index, decoration, deletion, insertion and diagram element was read against both witness texts, including their agreements. Nineteen distinct contextual crops were made once at the recorded original bounds, enlarged to width 3000 pixels with LANCZOS, autocontrast and UnsharpMask(radius=1.05, percent=105, threshold=4), and personally inspected. Existing relation_box and triangle crops were later reused for local overlaps/contours; neither was recropped. The citation and groupoid_end images were successfully inspected individually after an earlier paired output failed to display. There was no OCR, outside research or compilation.

The manuscript number is 115; scan/archive bookkeeping is not treated as a discrepancy against H. The page is upright handwritten working text in the main hand. No additional title or date is visible. The final source has the opening continuation, two cancellations, two legible insertions, map (11), boxed relation (12), its three brace labels and basepoint phrase, the left-margin drawing, and the closing presentation sentence.

H is an unverified second witness. Its supplied text contains a prose description of the triangle; no underlying separate H drawing file was supplied, so that project drawing cannot be assessed. Drawing rows identify concrete absent heads, contours or overwritten ink in the supplied prose and C code; the mere difference between prose and TikZ is never a change row. H's final note explicitly says the star/dot dispositions are uncertain, so marked_in_H is true for local decoration disagreements covered by that note, although those formulas do not individually contain its uncertainty macro.

Agreements personally retained include the opening les trois * signifient qu’on a enlevé, the upper insertion tous, the list 0,1,infinity, comme, on définirait de même and etc.; surface à bord; the complete set-complement equality X minus S = X minus {R_phi | phi in S}; Les points R_r^{ij}, et les chemins précédents, regardés, le plus commodément, comme points et chemins; the complete canoniques / pas seulement des classes d’homotopie parenthesis; On notera que les R_phi (phi in S) ne sont pas dans; mais dans l’application C-infinity; analytique réelle and canonique. The underline belongs to sont pas, not ne. H italics standing for that underline are not a collation row.

Also retained after reading are the plain single rightward arrow in (11) and the target X; R_r^{ij} va sur R_r^i=R_phi; où phi est le ... de type i de r; the un-hatted uppercase Pi_1 and untilded X in the introduction to (12); all six lambda/a subscripts r, their superscripts 0,1,infinity in written order, the three inverse -1 exponents, the three brace labels b_r^infinity,b_r^1,b_r^0 and final =1; the basepoint R_r^{1infinity}; and the final words Les sommets ... les flèches ... et les relations ... forment une présentation du groupoïde. No index or tilde is supplied by mathematical expectation.

The opening short upright is kept as uncertain graphical ink, rather than being silently omitted or asserted to be a prime. The live zero in the type key is retraced rather than independently struck. The middle variant has preferred upper-left dot, alternative star; the preferred content of C is unchanged and this confidence change alone creates no C disagreement. The semicolon at the opening has a separate dot above a hook. The comma after chemins is preserved.

The three-star layout is not regularized globally: at the second tilde-X in the On notera sentence the two upper marks and one lower central mark are preserved as that local triangle. The detached looped/angular ink beneath the following dash is not guessed as a word and has no secure separate cancellation stroke. It remains an uncertain small graphic in its written position.

The analytic parenthesis remains a consequential reading uncertainty. The preferred ink is et followed by =, the latter an unexpanded même abbreviation; the alternative is a not-equal sign. The two surviving horizontal bars and lower-left small glyph, not any expectation about real blow-ups, decide the ordering. Spelled non is not supported. No real-analyticity claim has been proved or refuted in this reading.

Le point is live, despite heavy tracing in Le. The later point is independently crossed out and replaced above by sommet. Donc is cancelled but readable; resolving C's doubt on that word is a certainty change, while H's unreadable placeholder is an actual local reading difference.

In (12) the second closing parenthesis is a separate thin downward curve immediately to the left of the entry stroke of a_r^0. Its low-left ending remains distinguishable after one reuse of the existing crop, so both parentheses are retained with C/H. The first brace label reads def without a separate acute. The source phrase is lacet en. All three brace associations and every exponent were read; that visual verification is not a proof of the relation.

The small triangle is preserved in the left margin beside the lower part of the relation. The three directed outer sides and the three corner arcs are distinct. Its inner horizontal segment has two opposed heads, followed by a rising branch with a further upper-right head. The thick wedge at the lower endpoint of the 0-corner arc is reproduced as an ink contour without declaring it a second directed edge. Gaps at the drawn apex and near 1 are physical pen gaps and are not asserted to disconnect the mathematical vertices. The heavy lower-right cluster may overlie an older infinity or zero; its identity and deletion state remain uncertain and are represented graphically.

The closing citation is literal (17), with a descending 7 and no lower 2 foot. It is retained even though the boxed relation on this page is numbered (12); whether this is a source slip or a reference elsewhere is not decided here. The final family has an actual comma in the superscript i,j. Its opening delimiter favors a heavily retraced brace, while both closing delimiters are round; this unmatched source punctuation is not repaired.
